intro: Place 5 buildings next to one another. Keep the workshop beside the unloading route and the nursery beside the kitchen. Build what you need and expand as required.

phases.title: 1 · Survival station
phases.goal: Secure respawning, food, and tools before building a large base.
exit: A sleeping place and spare gear are ready.
Water, food, and a safe escape route are available.

phases.title: 2 · Production base
phases.goal: Bring resources in, process them, and store them along a short workflow.
exit: The Smithy/forge are working and materials have dedicated storage.
Powered or fueled machines have a steady supply.

phases.title: 3 · Garden & farming tames
phases.goal: Sustain vegetables, kibble, food, and transport.
exit: The garden is irrigated and fertilized.
Farming and transport Dino are fed and have a clear exit.

phases.title: 4 · Breed a boss team
phases.goal: Reduce repetitive work and focus on breeding and expedition preparation.
exit: Breeding lines, baby food, and imprinting space are ready.
Cave/boss route kits and a recovery point are prepared.

phases.title: 5 · Tek upgrades
phases.goal: Upgrade bottlenecks after unlocking the engrams; keep a backup workflow.
exit: Use only technology unlocked through the correct boss/map.
Stock enough Element and suitable fuel before replacing machines.

zones.name: Main house
zones.purpose: Respawn, store personal gear, and prepare for trips.
zones.placement: Place it beside the other buildings with a transport lane between them.
steps: Keep active equipment downstairs; put beds and spare gear upstairs.
Use clearly marked storage for cave, ocean, and cold-weather kits.
Place a backup respawn point some distance from the main house.
Keep a bed, spare gear, and return transport at the outpost.
Check each map/cave's building rules and settings before placing structures.
Do not block artifacts, resource spawns, or cave entrances.

zones.name: Workshop & resource storage
zones.purpose: Receive resources, smelt, and craft here; keep shared power and water systems here too.
zones.placement: Place it beside the other buildings with a transport lane between them.
zones.flow: Metal → Forge → Ingot → Fabricator; chemical materials → Chemistry Bench
zones.size: Suggested size: 6×6 with high ceilings; test machine footprints first
steps: Start with a Smithy and Refining Forge; leave space for upgrades.
Build a Fabricator once metal, paste, and oil supplies are stable.
Choose Industrial Forge/Chemistry Bench upgrades according to the bottleneck; no upgrade order is optimal for every save.
Leave transport lanes for Dino and enough room for large machines.
Separate metal/stone, wood/fiber, organic materials, and blueprints into storage groups.
Store heavy materials near the machines that use them to reduce trips.
Tek Dedicated Storage is a late-game upgrade; build storage before unlocking Tek.
ASA uses power/water coverage areas; do not copy ASE wiring and pipe systems.
Check machines at the edge of coverage; distance alone does not prove they work.
Keep reserve fuel and a backup water source.
Tek is an upgrade after unlocking it, not a requirement for an early-game base.

zones.name: Kitchen & greenhouse
zones.purpose: Grow vegetables, cook kibble, and store food in one building.
zones.placement: Place it beside the other buildings with a transport lane between them.
zones.flow: Water + fertilizer → Crop Plot → vegetables → kitchen
zones.size: Suggested size: 4×6; expand to meet consumption
steps: Check irrigation before planting seeds.
Maintain fertilizer and check the greenhouse effect; the roof must satisfy greenhouse mechanics.
Grow the four basic vegetables; add defensive plants around the perimeter if needed.
Dino can provide fertilizer; Dung Beetle is a useful option, not a requirement.
A Cooking Pot and Preserving Bin are enough to get started.
Upgrade to an industrial cooker only when you need bulk production.
Separate ingredients from finished food; check power, water, and spoil timers.

zones.name: Dino shelter
zones.purpose: Park and feed farming Dino; provide a straight route from the gate to storage.
zones.placement: Place it beside the other buildings with a transport lane between them.
zones.flow: Tame → check saddle/food → yard → farming trip
zones.size: Size for your largest Dino; test its turning space
steps: Leave a route to the workshop for Argy and material-carrying Dino.
Keep taming pens/traps separate; do not lure wild creatures into the main herd.
Cryopod and Cryofridge behavior depends on ASA rules and settings; check your save before relying on them completely.

zones.name: Nursery
zones.purpose: Incubate eggs, raise babies, and imprint; place it beside the kitchen for quick food access.
zones.placement: Place it beside the other buildings with a transport lane between them.
zones.flow: Parents → eggs → incubation → babies → imprint → boss team
zones.size: Suggested size: 6×6; provide an outside yard for large species
steps: Check the temperature requirements of each species; no fixed air-conditioner count works for every egg.
Very young babies need food in their inventory according to species mechanics; do not assume a trough feeds every baby from birth.
Label parents and base stats; leave a separate area for mutations.
The boss nursery needs enough room for fully grown creatures and a clear route to the gate.
